text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Fubuki was in the middle of a "cute♡" competition against Vampy at the "R&A Resort". The night their collab dance unexpectedly went viral, in one corner of the night pool...
text_block_list.orig_text:
『R＆Aリゾート』で、
ヴァンピィと『カワイイ♡』勝負中のフブキ。
コラボダンス投稿が思いのほかバズった夜、
ナイトプールの片隅で──

text_block_list.text: Ihihi♡ Target: SPOTTED~♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
いひひっ♡　
ターゲット、
はっけ～ん♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Get him, Izuna~♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
イっちゃえ、
イズナ～♡

text_block_list.name: Izuna
text_block_list.text: Kyu kyuu!
text_block_list.orig_text: きゅきゅーっ！

text_block_list.name: Izuna
text_block_list.text: Kyu kyu♪
text_block_list.orig_text: きゅきゅっ♪

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Nice, nabbed myself a Newb Big Bro♡ Good girl, Izuna♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
は～い、
ザコお兄さんゲット～♡
イズナ、
いーこいーこ♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Whoa, that's a cold response... Don't tell me you've grown tired of seeing me in a swimsuit already?
text_block_list.orig_text:
う～わ、
塩対応～……
まさか
ぼくの水着、
見飽きたとか言わないよね～？

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Ah, guess it's the other way around~♡ You got captivated by me again, didn't you~♡ Well, guess it's my fault for being just too gorgeous♪♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
逆かぁ～♡
もしかしなくてもぉ、
また見惚れちゃったんだぁ～♡
ま、
しょーがないか♡　
ぼくがびしょーじょすぎるのが悪いんだしぃ♪

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: ...Just kidding. I could see you rolling your eyes, newb Big Bro... Oh...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
──なーんて、
目ん玉ザコお兄さんは
どーせまた塩たい……
お……？

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: I-I'm cute obviously! I'm a genius when it comes to choosing my appearance! ...Hehe♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
か、
かわいいのは当然だしっ！？
あったり前じゃん
ぼくは天才びしょーじょなんだからっ！
……
ふふん♪

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: ...M-O-R-E IMP-OR-TAN-TLY♪ You're bored right now, aren't you? How hopeless~ Guess I've got no choice~ I'll graciously work you to the bone♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
……そ・
れ・
よ・
り♪　
ザコお兄さん
ヒマなんでしょ？
しょ～がないなぁ～、
とくべつに、
ぼくがこき使ってあげる♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Ta-dah♡ Did you know there's a super exciting challenge happening at this resort right now? It's the "Night Pool Summer Challenge"♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
じゃーん♡　
今ここのリゾートで
ちょー熱いチャレンジやってんの、
知ってる？
『ナイトプール満喫
サマーチャレンジ』♪

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: If you complete all the photo, video, and live streams requested... you'll get an incentive, and you can even shoot up the trending rankings♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
写真・
動画・
配信、
ぜ～んぶコンプしたら、
インセンティブもらえちゃう仕組みでぇ、
人気急上昇のランキング入りもねらえちゃうワケ♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: I'm currently working solo, you see... and I'm desperately in need of submission ideas♡ We're gonna post all kinds of my cute moments♡ from your newbie point of view.
text_block_list.orig_text:
今ぼくソロで動いてるしぃ、
新しい投稿ネタほしくて♡
ぼくの色んな『かわいい♡』
を、
ザコお兄さん視点で投稿するの♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: So of course, you'll join me as my cameraman, right♡ Oh, you believe it's sneaky to do something of the sort during my match with Vampy?
text_block_list.orig_text:
そんで当然、
ザコお兄さんがカメラマンね♡
あ、
ヴァンピィとの勝負中に抜け駆けはダメとか思ってる？

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Then, well... just help her next time~♡ That would be perfect, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
じゃあさ～、
次はあっちといけばいいじゃん♡
そんなら文句なしっしょ～？

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Right, right~♡ (Well, I'll be getting in their way when that happens♡)
text_block_list.orig_text:
でしょでしょ～♡
（ま、
そん時はぼくがおジャマしちゃうんですけどぉ♡）

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Nothing at all♡ So, I'm counting on you to do a lot of filming starting tonight♡ Ah, and you'll also be my baggage carrier, chair setup guy, and drink runner♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
な～んにも♡
ってワケで、
早速今夜から撮影たんとー
ヨロシクね～♡
あ、
荷物持ちとか
椅子とかドリンク係も兼任で♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: That's too bad~♡ A newb like you has no right to "refuse"~ So~ Izuna, hold him in place~
text_block_list.orig_text:
ざんね～ん♡
ザコお兄さんにキョヒケンはありませ～ん♡
ってなワケで──
イズナ、
お兄さん足止めっ♡

text_block_list.name: Izuna
text_block_list.text: Kyu kyu♪
text_block_list.orig_text: きゅきゅっ♪

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Announcement posted... and upload complete~♡ Look, all my fans are looking forward to my video~♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
告知、
からの～……
トーコーかんりょ～♡
ほーら、
ファンのみんなも
ぼくの動画を楽しみに待ってるって～♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: A kind, unassuming Newb Big Bro like you couldn't possible betray their expectations, right♡ You can't refuse, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
やさしいザコお兄さんは、
みんなの期待を裏切れないよね～♡
断れないよね～？

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Huh?
text_block_list.orig_text: は？

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Ugh...! Damn you... Why do you always have to hit me with the logical argument!? That really pisses me off~!
text_block_list.orig_text:
う
ぐっ……！　
ザコお兄さんのくせに、
毎回毎回正論ぶつけてくんなし！？
そーゆーとこ、
ほんっとムカつくんですけどぉ～！

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Auu...!? Wait, wait, wait! I get it, I understand! I'll tell you! I'll ask properly~...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あぅっ……！？　
待った待った待った！
わかった、
わかったってば！
言うし、
ちゃんと言うしぃ～っ……！

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: P... P-Ple... Please, help me...♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ぉ、ぉ……
ぉ願い…………
しますっ……♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Khhhhh! Damn you Newb Big Bro! I'll remember this! ...Ah, I know♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
う゛～～～っ！　
ザコお兄さんのくせにぃ～っ！！
覚えてろぉ～！
……あ、
そーだ♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Hey, hey~ Newb Big Bro~♡ About our main filming location~♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
ねぇねぇ～
ザコお兄さ～ん？♡
カンジンの撮影場所なんだけどぉ～♪

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Ta-dah♡! I actually managed to get my hands on a pair of "Heart-Throbbing♡Water Slide" tickets~♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
じゃーん♡
実はぁ
『どきどき♡ウォータースライダー』
チケット、
ゲットしちゃったんだよね～♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Ihihi, lol. Bet you'll end up in tears, you newb~♡ Well... If that were to happen you're free to ask me for help~♡ On your knees, of course♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
いひひｗ　
どきどきしすぎて
ザコお兄さん
涙目になっちゃうかもね～♡
そしたら
「助けてください」って
お願いしてもいーよ♡　
ドゲザつきで♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Mmmmm... I can't.

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: I CAN'T, THIS IS IMPOSSIBLE! It's so high up, it's cold and isn't this angle totally aiming down?! I can't see anything below!
text_block_list.orig_text:
無理むりムリ～っ！！
高いし、
寒いし、
ほぼ直角だし！？
下ぜんぜん見えないんですけど！？

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: I mean! Are they trying to hide how life-threatening this is by going with that "Heart-throbbing" remark?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ってか
『どきどき♡』
ってかわいい響きでごまかしといて
ガチで命の危機レベルのコースってどゆコト！？

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: The name and the ride have nothing in common! That's false advertising!! Say something, management!!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
名前と中身ちがいすぎて詐欺じゃ～ん！！
ウンエー出てこ～い！！

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text: Dear guest~♪ The next guests in line have been waiting for a while~♪ Please make sure to get ready~♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
お客様～♪　
次のお客様、
お待ちですので～♪
ご準備、
お早めにお願いしまーす♪

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Ugh...! I-I know that! I was just enjoying the scenery! Don't rush a genius beauty!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ぐっ……！　
わ、
わかってるし！
ちょっと景色たのしんでただけだしっ！
天才びしょーじょを急かすなっつーの！

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Huh...?! Aahn? I-I'm not scared at all, though~? Who would be scared by such a lame slider? But...
text_block_list.orig_text:
はっ……！？　
はぁ～～～？
ビ、
ビビってませんけど～？
誰がこんなショボいスライダーでビビるってのぉ？　
でも──

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Ehehe♡ I'll let you go first, newb Big Bro♡ You've gotta get the perfect shot of my cuteness from down there, right~?
text_block_list.orig_text:
えへへ♡
ザコお兄さんに、
先、
ゆずってあげる♡
下でぼくのカワイイとこ、
ばっちり撮らなきゃだしぃ～？

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Ihihihi♡ If he gets through it safely, I can do it too♪ He'll be my guinea pig for safety testing♡ Truly an honor for cute little me~♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
いっひっひ♡　
お兄さんが無事だったら、
ぼくもいっちゃお～♪　
安全確認の実験台♡
かわいいぼくのためなんだから、
光栄だよね～♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Eh?
text_block_list.orig_text: え？

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Huh...? W-Wait, wha...!? Or rather, Onii-san... AREN'T YOU A LITTLE TOO USED TO FALLING?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
は……っ？　
ちょ、
待っ……！？
ってかお兄さん、
落ちるの慣れすぎじゃね……！？

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Huh? What's this? It's from him?
text_block_list.orig_text:
え、
なになに……
ザコお兄さんから？

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Khhhhh~!! For a pathetic little newbie like him to say this~!! He's really provoking me~!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うぅ～～～！！
ザコザコよわよわお兄さんのくせに～～！！
めっっっちゃ煽ってくるじゃん～～！！

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Watch meeeee!! With my cute glide I'll earn all sorts of "Loves", and I'll leave you to shrivel up in a desert with no love left for you~! TOH!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
見てろぉお～～～！！
ぼくのカワイイ滑走で全部ラヴ持ってって、
ザコお兄さんなんて
ラヴ砂漠でひからびさせてやる～！　
とぉっ！！

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text:
Ah. I-I can't handle this after all~
NYAAAAAAAAH~?!
NO, NO, NOOOOOOOOOOOOOOO~!!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ。
やっぱだめ──
にゃぁああ～～～～！？　
やだやだやだぁああ～～～っ！！！

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: H-Hmph...! T-That was totally easy for me!? If anything, it wasn't nearly thrilling enough~!?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふっ……
ふんっ！
ぜ、
ぜんっぜんよゆーだったし！？
あんなの
まだまだ物足りないってゆーかぁ～！？

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: I-I'm not trembling or anything!? T-That's just because the water's a little cold and it's giving my muscles a nice stretch! As if I'd be screaming like Sis Baka-na!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふ、
震えてないし！？　
こ、
これはちょっと水が冷たくて
筋肉がイイ感じにストレッチされてるだけだし！
バカナ姉みたいな悲鳴とかあげてませんし～っ！

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: So what? A recording like that would never get any Loves~ ...Ah♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
だから何？　
あんなのぜったい
ラヴつかな──……
あ♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: No way, I've gotten so many Loves♡ Yay~♡ If I complete this with a last stream, I'm bound to win that incentive♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
うっそ、
たくさんラヴついてる♡
やった～♡　
最後の配信コンプすれば
インセンティブもけっこー入りそうじゃん♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Crap, I can't wait~♡ What are you doing, Newb Big Bro? Come on, let's hurry up and go to the next streaming location~♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
ヤバ、
楽しみ～♡
何やってんのザコお兄さん？
ほら、
はやく次の配信場所行くよ～♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Huh? Why are there so many people? They're getting in the way! Oh well, I guess I'll have to use my water gun to forcibly move them out of the way~
text_block_list.orig_text:
は？　
なんでこんなに人いんの？
ジャマすぎなんですけど？
しょーがないなぁ、
ぼくの水鉄砲ちゃんで
強制的にどいてもら──

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Eeeh?! But we can't broadcast with this crowd! If you're going to stop me, then YOU do something about it, Newb Big Bro!
text_block_list.orig_text:
え～っ！
このままじゃ配信できないじゃん！
ストップってんなら
ザコお兄さん何とかしてよ～～！？

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Huuuh? What do you mean by "make"? ...Ah, now I get it!
text_block_list.orig_text:
はぁ？　
作るってナニを──
……あっ、
そーゆーこと！？

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: If I can't use the best place, then I'll just make one myself~! Pretty sharp for a newb like you~♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
場所がないなら
いっちゃんいい場所、
自分で作っちゃえばいいじゃん～～！
ザコお兄さんにしちゃ冴えてるぅ～♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Hmm hmm hm hmm♪ Found a perfectly photogenic spot♡ The spherical lights should go like this, and the inner tube... I think this motif's the winner♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふんふんふ～ん♪　
映えそうな場所見っけ♡
球体ライトはこ～んなカンジで、
浮き輪はぁ……
ぼくモチーフが勝利っしょ♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: I did it♡ Making a pool in the ocean... I guess geniuses like me really are on a whole different level~♪ I get to have all the cute lights and inflatable rings to myself♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
できちゃった♡
海にプール作っちゃうとか
天才はやっぱレベルが違うっていうか～♪
かわいいライトも浮き輪も、
ぜーんぶ独り占め♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Well, a lot of stuff did happen while we got it all ready...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ま、
準備中はイロイロあったけどぉ……

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Whoa, whoa!! I'm falling here, I really am! Ah, hey, Newb Big Bro, don't laugh! I TOLD YOU NOT TO!!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
わわわっ、
落ちる落ちるぅ～！
あっ、
こらザコお兄さん笑うなぁ～！
笑うなっつーの～～！！

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Huh? Isn't getting the preparations ready your job here♡? I'll watch over you from here, so do your best, do your best~ ♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
え～？　
準備はぜ～んぶお兄さんの仕事じゃん♡
ぼくはここで見ててあげるから、
がんばれがんばれ～♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Eh, hey......!? Why did you stand up... No way, you're angry at me!? I'll do it! I'll also help! Please forgive me!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
──えっ、ちょ……！？
なんで立ち上がっ……
うそ、
お兄さん怒ってる！？
やる！　
ぼくもやるから！　
許してってばぁ～～！！

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Now, now... what's done is done, so it doesn't really matter♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
まーまー、
終わったことはどーでもいーっしょ♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Anyway! A stream from here is bound to go viral♪ Onii-san, you really are reliable sometimes♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
とにかく！　
ここで配信とか、
映え確定だし♪
お兄さん、
やればできるじゃん♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Ihihi♡ I'll give you a special compliment, just this once~♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
いひひっ♡　
とくべつにぃ、
ほめてあげる～♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: There it is again! Cold as ever! And yet, you even went and got me ice cream~♡ You really do love me too much~♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
出た！　
塩対応！
のくせに、
アイスまで準備しちゃってくれてさ～♡
お兄さんってほんっと
ぼくのこと、
好きすぎ♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: ...Though, maybe this is better than going viral in the middle of a huge crowd♡ Getting to film with just you... might be a little luckier, I guess♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ま、
人ごみのなかでバズるよりさ♡
お兄さんと二人っきりで撮るほうが、
ちょっとだけ、
ラッキーかもね♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: I-It's nothing! I'll reward you with something nice♡ A livestream led by a genius beauty♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
──な、
なんでもないし！
そんなお兄さんに、
ごほーび♡
天才びしょーじょの配信、
ナマで見せてあげる♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Okay, let's start the stream♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
んじゃ、
配信スタート♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Crap~ The number of Loves is really growing♡ As expected of... ME♡ My fans really do know how cute I am♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
やっば～
ラヴ数すっごい伸びてる♡
さっすがぼく♡　
ファンのみんなも、
ちゃーんとぼくのカワいさわかってんじゃん♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Now then, what about their comments? Please give me lots of praise~♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
さ～て、
コメントは～？
いっぱいヨイショしてよね～♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text:
"Being bossed around by Fubuki-chan is a reward in itself."
"Pick me instead! I wanna be Fubuki-chan's slave!"
Oh my gosh♡ You really do get it, my loyal fans♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
『フブキちゃんにパシられるお兄さん、
ご褒美でしかない』
『自分もっとやれます！　
フブキちゃんのドレーになりたいです！』
やっだ～♡　
ファンのみんな、
わかってるぅ～♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text:
See, Newb Big Bro? You should be grateful~ lol
Getting to be my errand boy means you've already won at life~♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほら、
ザコお兄さん
感謝しなよ～？ｗ
ぼくのパシリになれるとか、
超・勝ち組じゃ～ん♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: ...Huh? What's this comment... "Sitting in seiza waiting for Onii-san's correction arc lol"?! As if I'd let him correct me!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……は？
『お兄さんのわからせ下剋上展開、
正座で待機ｗ』
ってなに！？
下剋上なんかさせないっつーの！

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: First of all, there's no way a newb like him could beat me! It's my job to put a pathetic little newb like him in his place!
text_block_list.orig_text:
第一、
ザコお兄さんがぼくにかなうワケないじゃん！？
ザコザコザコザコお兄さんをわからせんのは、
ぼくの役目なんですけど！？

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: I mean, because of him... isn't my "Super Genius, Super Gorgeous Mistress♡" persona being completely misunderstood~!?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ってかお兄さんのせーで、
ぼくの『ちょー天才でちょー美少女なご主人サマ♡路線』が
カン違いされてるし～！？

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: I'm supposed to be the one putting Newb Big Bro in "his place", not the one getting put "in mine"! You're all newb fans who don't understand!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ぼくはザコお兄さんを『わからせる』側で、
『わからされる』側じゃないんですけど～！？
ファンも、
ぼくのことわかってないザコすぎ！

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Argh, geez! You're pissing me off! Newb Big Bro, stop the stream! We're doing this over!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ～
もうムカつく！
ザコお兄さん、
配信ストップして！　
やり直し！

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: THAT AGAIN!?
text_block_list.orig_text: そこから！？

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text:
Huh...?! "Correction arc already starting lol"
"Fubuki-chan's got a soft spot for Onii-san lol"
"Is this a real correction happening live?!"...?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
は……っ！？
『さっそくわからせ展開ｗ』
『フブキちゃん、
お兄さんに弱いｗ』
『ガチで下剋上きた！？』──！？

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: For a lousy Newb Big Bro... you've sure gotten cocky...! And the rest of you... just you wait!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ザコお兄さんのくせに、
えらそーに……！
おまえらも、
覚えてろぉ～！！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: In the end, after much agonizing, Fubuki finally managed to force out a reluctant "Please", and her cameraman arrangement with {0} lasted throughout the rest of the summer.
text_block_list.orig_text:
結局──
フブキは苦悩の末『お願いします』を絞り出し、
{0}とのカメラマン契約は、
夏の間続くのだった。
